verdict.label: mixed
verdict.headline: Faster trips along the Eastside, with the risk landing on renters near the new stops.

personas.name: Tasha
personas.descriptor: Commutes to Georgia Tech · renter in Cabbagetown
personas.quote: My trip to Georgia Tech goes from 57 to 39 minutes. That's real time back every morning.
cannedReplies: By the model's numbers my commute is 57 minutes today and 39 minutes with the line.
My block isn't in the rent-pressure zone, so rent isn't my main worry.
I'm not near the construction zone.
I'd pay about $30 a year toward it either way.
